messages.author: swarm
messages.text:
What it is: Bug HIGH: operator false-freezes on a stale or unreadable usage-limit cooldown (nil-reset cooldown never elapses; stale pane banner renews a ~24h reset) — make cooldown evaluation fail-OPEN
What it solves: A false-freeze = the operator sits in :cooldown (won't launch the disposable LLM) when
it should be :available -> the Operator silently does nothing (health checks, nudges,
recovery all stop). HIGH because the Operator is the swarm's recovery delegate.
How it works: A usage-limit banner with a readable, not-yet-elapsed reset keeps the operator frozen until that reset (genuine cooldown respected, no regression)
